slides.texte_overlay:
Hobbies that train
your brain like a gym
Learning to draw. Observing shapes, light and proportion trains attention and patience. Start with simple objects on your desk.
Cooking new cuisines. Recipes from other countries teach planning, timing and creativity, and you learn about cultures too.
Dancing. Remembering steps, following rhythm and coordinating your body is a full workout for your brain. Take one class.
Birdwatching. Identifying species by sight and sound trains memory and focus, and it gets you outside. Bring binoculars.
Daily learning. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it's the easiest brain workout I've ever kept.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It's the easiest brain workout I've ever kept.

slides.texte_overlay: Doing card tricks. Practising sleight of hand trains memory, coordination and confidence when you perform for friends.
Learning to sail. Wind, ropes, navigation. Every trip is a puzzle that keeps your mind sharp and your body active. Start with a lesson.
